body.statement: On the mixed center in \(\text{prop:smooth-inclusion}\), the control propensity satisfies \(\inf_x\pi_0(x)=1/2\), \(t_{0,n}\to1/2\), \(h_{0,n}\to2\), \(\widehat p_{0,(\lceil\widehat h_{0,n}\rceil)}\to_P1/2\), and \(\widehat b_{0,n}\to_P\vartheta_0/2<1/2\). Thus clipping is asymptotically inactive on the control arm, its drift correction is exactly zero by construction, and its feasible objective equals the untrimmed fitted-weight objective with probability tending to one.
body.justification: This recomputation removes the nonvanishing-clipping error created by allowing multipliers above one.
body.gap: This is a required sanity reduction, not a novelty claim.
body.consumer: It verifies that the feasible rule targets the untrimmed control quantile on the explicit mixed-regime witness.
